convert_types.description:
List of types to auto-convert from.
For 'int' auto-conversion is supported from 'bool' and 'str'

convert_to_lower_case.description: Convert string value to lower case before performing validation

convert_types.description:
List of types to auto-convert from.
For 'str' auto-conversion is supported from 'bool' and 'int'

pattern.description:
A regular expression which will be matched on the variable value.
The regular expression should be valid according to the ECMA 262 dialect
Remember to use double escapes

items.$comment: Recursive reference to allow infinite nested data models

primary_key.$comment: The regex here matches valid key names
primary_key.description:
Name of a primary key in a list of dictionaries.
The configured key is implicitly required and must have unique values between the list elements

unique_keys.description: List of keys or dot-notation path keys that must be unique in addition to primary_key.

items.$comment: The regex here matches valid key names
items.description:
Name of a key in a list of dictionaries.
The configured key must have unique values between the list elements.
This can also be a variable path using dot-notation like 'parent_key.child_key' in case of nested lists of dictionaries.

allow_duplicate_primary_key.description: Set to True to allow duplicate primary_key values for a list of dicts. Useful when primary key is only used for triggering documentation. NOTE! Should only be used in eos_designs inputs since we cannot merge on primary key if there are duplicate entries.

keys.description:
Dictionary of dictionary-keys in the format `{<keyname>: {<schema>}}`.
`keyname` must use snake_case.
`schema` is the schema for each key. This is a recursive schema, so the value must conform to AVD Schema
keys.$comment: Recursive reference to allow infinite nested data models

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.$comment: The regex here matches valid key names

dynamic_keys.description:
Dictionary of dynamic dictionary-keys in the format `{<variable.path>: {<schema>}}`.
`variable.path` is a variable path using dot-notation and pointing to a variable under the parent dictionary containing dictionary-keys.
If an element of the variable path is a list, every list item will unpacked.
`schema` is the schema for each key. This is a recursive schema, so the value must conform to AVD Schema
Note that this is building the schema from values in the _data_ being validated!

allow_other_keys.description: Allow keys in the dictionary which are not defined in the schema.

display_name.description: Free text display name for forms and documentation (single line)

description.description: Free text description for forms and documentation (multi line)

items.description:
Path to variable under the parent dictionary containing valid values.
Variable path use dot-notation and variable path must be relative to the parent dictionary.
If an element of the variable path is a list, every list item will be unpacked.
Note that this is building the schema from values in the _data_ being validated!

$ref.description:
Reference to Sub Schema using JSON Schema resolver.
Example '#/keys/mykey' will resolve the schema for 'mykey' under the root dictionary of the current schema

documentation_options.description: Special options used for generating documentation

table.description:
Setting 'table' will allow for custom grouping of schema fields in the documentation.
By default each root key has it's own table. By setting the same table-value on multiple keys, they will be merged to a single table.
If 'table' is set on a 'child' key, all 'ancestor' keys are automatically included in the table so the full path is visible.
The 'table' option is inherited to all child keys, unless specifically set on the child.

documentation_options_dict.description: Special options used for generating documentation

hide_keys.description:
Prevent keys of the dict from being displayed in the generated documentation.
This is used for structured_config where we wish to avoid displaying the full EOS Config schema everywhere.

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.$comment: The regex here matches valid key names

cli.description: Options for driving CLI config rendering from schema annotations

separator.description: Emit a '!' line before the section header

section.description: Template for the CLI block header line (dict only). Variables like {as} are resolved from the dict's own data.

line.description: Template for a single CLI body line. Variables are resolved from the parent dict's data (sibling keys).

line_fragments.description: Ordered fragments concatenated into one CLI line (dict only). The first fragment is the anchor — if it has {placeholders} that don't resolve, the whole line is skipped. Subsequent fragments are appended only when all their placeholders resolve. If no data fragment resolves, the line is skipped.

lines.description: Multiple CLI body lines for one dict (dict only). Each template is resolved independently from the dict's own data. A line is emitted only if all its placeholders resolve. Supports the '?field_path' (truthy-required) and '?!field_path' (truthy-forbidden) guard suffixes from item_lines.

gate.description: One or more truthy guards. Each expression is a field path that may be prefixed with '!' to negate the check and/or '^' to evaluate against the parent data context. The field renders only when all expressions resolve truthy. Examples: 'enabled', '!enabled', '^enabled', '!^enabled', ['enabled', '!^enabled'].

bool_true_line.description: Fixed CLI line emitted verbatim when the field value is True (bool only).

bool_false_line.description: Fixed CLI line emitted verbatim when the field value is False (bool only).

item_lines.description: List of line templates applied to each list item (list only). For scalar items use {_item}.

item_line_fragments.description: Per-item version of line_fragments (list only). For each list item, build one composite line from an ordered fragment list. Same anchor + optional fragments + ?guard semantics as line_fragments.

item_gate.description: Per-item gate using the same syntax as cli.gate (supports !, ^, ||). Items where the gate fails are skipped entirely.

sort_key.description: Field name to natural-sort list items by before rendering. AvdIndexedList items are always sorted by their primary key — sort_key is ignored there.

section_only_if_content.description: Skip the section header if no child lines were rendered.

warning.description: Emit deprecation warning if key is set

removed.description: Support for this key has been removed

remove_in_version.description: Version in which the key will be removed

remove_after_date.description: Date after which the key will be removed in the next major version

url.description: URL detailing the deprecation and migration guidelines

allow_with_new_key.description: Allow the deprecated key to be used in parallel with the new key without raising a conflict error
